Coverage_Description: Guaranteed monthly income for 50 years plus non-guaranteed monthly income until policy end; death benefit is the higher of 100% of total premiums paid or 101% guaranteed cash value plus terminal bonus (less outstanding loans); maturity benefit payable at initial insured age 151
pricing: US$200,000/year (illustrative case, age 55, 5-year premium payment term).
customer requirement: Insured must be at least 15 days old at application; no health information required if total nominal amount is within the administrative limit
price structure: 3-year or 5-year pay; designated insurance rate by pay term, same rate across age, gender, smoking status, and residence
additional informations: Unlimited insured change, one contingent insured allowed, and policy split option available from policy year 5
